questions.text: अपने विस्तारित रूप 'डोरी पर बीड्स' के रूप में क्रोमेटीन में डोरी में 'बीड्स' निरूपित करते हैं :
questions.text_english: In its extended 'beads-on-string' form of chromatin, the 'beads' in the string represent:
questions.solution: The correct option is Nucleosomes. In the chromatin network, the repeating structural units are called nucleosomes, which appear as 'beads on a string' under an electron microscope. Each nucleosome consists of a core of eight histone proteins wrapped by DNA.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प न्यूक्लियोसोम है। क्रोमेटिन नेटवर्क में, दोहराई जाने वाली संरचनात्मक इकाइयों को न्यूक्लियोसोम कहा जाता है, जो एक इलेक्ट्रॉन माइक्रोस्कोप के नीचे 'स्ट्रिंग पर मोती' के रूप में दिखाई देते हैं।

questions.text:
मानव नर जनन तंत्र की सहायक नलिकाओं के संदर्भ में कुछ कथन नीचे दिए गए हैं :
(i) वृषण की शुक्रजनक नलिकाएँ (सेमिनिफेरस ट्यूबुल्स) वृषण जालिकाओं (रेटे टेस्टिस) में खुलती हैं जो आगे जाकर शुक्रवाहिका (वास डेफेरेंस) में खुलती हैं।
(ii) शुक्रवाहिकाएँ (वास इफेरेंशिया) वृषण से निकलकर अधिवृषण (ऐपिडिडिमिस) में खुलती हैं।
(iii) ये अधिवृषण शुक्रवाहिका की ओर बढ़ते हुए उदर की ओर ऊपर जाती हैं।
(iv) शुक्रवाहिका में प्रोस्टेट ग्रंथि से एक वाहिनी आती है और मूत्रमार्ग में स्खलनीय वाहिनी के रूप में खुलती है।
(v) मूत्रमार्ग का उद्भव मूत्राशय से होता है तथा पुरुष के शिश्न के माध्यम से गुज़रता हुआ बाहर की ओर एक छिद्र, मूत्राशय मुख (यूरेथ्रल मीऐटस) के रूप में खुलता है।
दिए गए विकल्पों से उस विकल्प को चुनिए जिसके सभी कथन सत्य हैं :
questions.text_english:
Given below are a few statements with reference to the accessory ducts of the human male reproductive system:
(i) The seminiferous tubules of the testes open into rete testis then into the vas deferens.
(ii) The vasa efferentia leave the testes and open into the epididymis.
(iii) The epididymis leads to vas deferens that ascends into the abdomen.
(iv) The vas deferens receives a duct from the prostrate gland and opens into the urethra as ejaculatory duct.
(v) The urethra originates from the urinary bladder and extends through the penis to its external opening, urethral meatus.
Choose the option with all true statements from the given options:
questions.solution: The correct option is (B). Statement (i) is incorrect because the rete testis opens into the vasa efferentia, not directly into the vas deferens. Statement (iv) is incorrect because the vas deferens receives a duct from the seminal vesicle, not the prostate gland, before opening into the urethra as the ejaculatory duct. Statements (ii), (iii), and (v) correctly describe the pathway and structure of the male accessory ducts.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प (B) है। कथन (i) गलत है क्योंकि वृषण जालिकाएँ वास एफेरेंशिया में खुलती हैं, न कि सीधे वास डेफेरेंस में। कथन (iv) गलत है क्योंकि वास डेफेरेंस को प्रोस्टेट ग्रंथि के बजाय सेमिनल वेसिकल से एक वाहिनी प्राप्त होती है। कथन (ii), (iii), और (v) बिल्कुल सत्य हैं।

questions.text: डीएनए प्रतिकृतियन के दौरान एंज़ाइम डीएनए-निर्भर डीएनए पॉलीमरेज के अवस्तर के रूप में उपयोग किया जाने वाला पदार्थ है :
questions.text_english: The substrate used during DNA replication by the enzyme DNA-dependent DNA polymerase is:
questions.solution: The correct option is Deoxyribonucleotide triphosphate. During DNA replication, deoxyribonucleotide triphosphates serve a dual purpose. They act as substrates for the DNA-dependent DNA polymerase to synthesize the new DNA strand and also provide energy for the polymerization reaction through the cleavage of their two terminal phosphates.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प डीऑक्सीराइबोन्यूक्लियोटाइड ट्राइफॉस्फेट है। डीएनए प्रतिकृतियन के दौरान, डीऑक्सीराइबोन्यूक्लियोटाइड ट्राइफॉस्फेट दोहरे उद्देश्य की पूर्ति करते हैं। वे सब्सट्रेट के रूप में कार्य करते हैं और ऊर्जा भी प्रदान करते हैं।

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए एक वंशावली चार्ट में, एक सामान्य दंपति (युगल) का एक पुत्र हीमोफीलिया रोग (विकार) से पीड़ित था जबकि पुत्री सामान्य थी। कुछ समय पश्चात्, जब इस पुत्री का विवाह एक सामान्य पुरुष के साथ हुआ, तो उन्हें आश्चर्य हुआ कि उनका पौत्र (नाती) भी हीमोफीलिया विकार ग्रस्त था। उस विकल्प को चुनिए जो उपर्युक्त वंशावली चार्ट में विशेषक की सही वंशागति को इंगित करता है :
questions.text_english: In the given pedigree chart, a cross between a normal couple resulted in a son who was haemophilic and a normal daughter. In course of time, when the daughter was married to a normal man, to their surprise the grandson was also haemophilic. Choose the option that indicates the correct inheritance of trait in the above pedigree chart:
questions.solution: The correct option is Sex-linked recessive trait. Since normal parents produce an affected son, the trait must be recessive. Because the daughter is phenotypically normal but passes the trait to her son, she must be a carrier, which is a hallmark of X-linked (sex-linked) recessive inheritance like haemophilia.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प लिंग-सहलग्न अप्रभावी विशेषक है। चूँकि सामान्य माता-पिता से एक प्रभावित पुत्र उत्पन्न होता है, इसलिए यह लक्षण अप्रभावी होना चाहिए। हीमोफीलिया एक X-सहलग्न अप्रभावी विकार है, जहाँ माँ वाहक के रूप में कार्य करती है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित मानव रोगों में से किस रोग में स्व-प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र अपने ही शरीर की कोशिकाओं पर हमला कर देता है ?
questions.text_english: In which of the following human diseases does the body's self-defence mechanism attack self-cells?
questions.solution: The correct option is Rheumatoid arthritis. It is an autoimmune disorder where the body's immune system abnormally identifies its own cells as foreign antigens and attacks the synovial membranes of the joints, leading to inflammation and pain.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प आमवाती संधिशोथ (रूमेटोयड आर्थाइटिस) है। यह एक स्व-प्रतिरक्षा रोग (autoimmune disease) है जिसमें प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र शरीर की अपनी ही कोशिकाओं पर हमला करता है।

questions.text:
दिए गए विकल्पों से उन कथनों को चुनिए जो एक प्रारूपी द्विबीजपत्री भ्रूण के लिए सत्य हैं।
(i) इसमें एक भ्रूणीय अक्ष तथा प्रशल्क (स्कुटेलम) होता है।
(ii) बीजपत्र के स्तर से ऊपर भ्रूणीय अक्ष का भाग बीजपत्रोपरिक होता है।
(iii) बीजपत्र के स्तर से नीचे का भ्रूणीय अक्ष का भाग मूलांकुर-चोल होता है।
(iv) भ्रूण का निचला सिरा मूलांकुर मूल गोप द्वारा आवृत होता है।
सही उत्तर चुनिए :
questions.text_english:
Select the statements that are true for a typical dicotyledonous embryo from the given options.
(i) It consists of an embryonal axis and scutellum.
(ii) The portion of embryonal axis above the level of cotyledon is epicotyl.
(iii) The portion of embryonal axis below the level of cotyledon is coleorhiza.
(iv) The lower end of the embryo has radicle covered with a root cap.
Choose the correct answer:
questions.solution: The correct option is (ii) and (iv). Statement (i) is incorrect because scutellum is a feature of monocot embryos, not dicots. Statement (iii) is incorrect as coleorhiza is the protective sheath of the radicle in monocots. Statements (ii) and (iv) accurately describe the epicotyl and the radicle with its root cap in a typical dicot embryo.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प (ii) और (iv) है। कथन (i) और (iii) गलत हैं क्योंकि स्कुटेलम और मूलांकुर-चोल एकबीजपत्री भ्रूण की विशेषताएँ हैं, द्विबीजपत्री की नहीं।

questions.text: लगभग 15 मिलियन वर्ष पूर्व मानव विकास के दौरान पाए जाने वाले नर-वानर जो गोरिल्ला एवं चिंपैंजी की तरह चलते थे, वे थे :
questions.text_english: About 15 mya during human evolution, the primates which used to walk like gorillas and chimpanzees were :
questions.solution: The correct option is Dryopithecus and Ramapithecus. According to fossil records, these primates existed around 15 million years ago. They were hairy and walked similarly to modern-day gorillas and chimpanzees.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प ड्रायोपिथिकस तथा रामापिथिकस है। जीवाश्म रिकॉर्ड के अनुसार, लगभग 15 मिलियन वर्ष पूर्व ये प्राइमेट्स गोरिल्ला और चिंपैंजी की तरह चलते थे।

questions.text:
यदि अनुलेखित किए जाने वाले संरचनात्मक जीन के कोडिंग रज्जुक का न्यूक्लियोटाइड अनुक्रम TAC है, तो स्थानांतरण प्रक्रिया के दौरान tRNA के 3' सिरे पर जुड़े (लगे) ऐमीनो अम्ल का चयन करने के लिए दी गई सूचना का उपयोग कीजिए।
ऐमीनो अम्लों के लिए कोडॉन :
AUC – आइसोल्यूसीन
AUG - मीथियोनीन
UAC - टाइरोसीन
GUA - वैलीन
questions.text_english:
Use the given information to select the amino acid attached to the 3' end of tRNA during the process of translation, if the coding strand of the structural gene being transcribed has the nucleotide sequence TAC.
Codons for the amino acids :
AUC-Isoleucine
AUG-Methionine
UAC-Tyrosine
GUA-Valine
questions.solution: The correct option is Tyrosine. The coding strand sequence is TAC. The transcribed mRNA will have the same sequence as the coding strand but with Uracil instead of Thymine, which makes the mRNA codon UAC. The codon UAC codes for the amino acid Tyrosine, which will be attached to the 3' end of its specific tRNA.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प टाइरोसीन है। कोडिंग रज्जुक का अनुक्रम TAC है, अतः उत्पन्न mRNA का अनुक्रम UAC होगा (T के स्थान पर U)। दिए गए कोडॉन के अनुसार UAC टाइरोसीन को कूटलेखित करता है।

questions.text: प्रतिजन-प्रतिपिंड की अन्योन्य (पारस्परिक) क्रिया के सिद्धान्त पर आधारित किसी रोग के प्रारंभ (शुरुआत) में पहचान की तकनीक है :
questions.text_english: The technique for the early detection of a disease based on the principle of antigen-antibody interaction is :
questions.solution: The correct option is ELISA. Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA) is a diagnostic technique that relies entirely on the specific interaction between an antigen and its corresponding antibody to detect the early presence of pathogens.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प एलिसा (ELISA) है। यह तकनीक प्रतिजन-प्रतिपिंड प्रतिक्रिया के सिद्धांत पर काम करती है और रोगों की शीघ्र पहचान में सहायक है।

questions.text: यह सिद्ध करने के लिए कि डीएनए अर्धसंरक्षी प्रतिकृतियन करता है, मैथ्यू मेसेल्सन एवं फ्रैंकलिन स्टाल द्वारा किए गए प्रयोग में अपकेन्द्रण द्वारा 40 मिनट बाद संवर्धन से निष्कर्षित किए गए डीएनए को ठीक (सही) प्रकार से प्रदर्शित करने वाला आरेख है :
questions.text_english: The correct depiction of the experiment performed by Matthew Meselson and Franklin Stahl to prove that DNA replicates semi-conservatively on separation of DNA by centrifugation after 40 minutes is:
questions.solution: The correct option is (C). E. coli divides every 20 minutes. After 40 minutes (two generations) in an N14 medium, the semi-conservative replication results in 50% hybrid DNA (N14-N15) and 50% light DNA (N14-N14), which is depicted as two bands of equal thickness in the centrifuge tube.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प (C) है। 40 मिनट बाद (दो पीढ़ियों के पश्चात), डीएनए का 50% भाग संकर (N14-N15) और 50% भाग हल्का (N14-N14) होता है, जो सेंट्रीफ्यूज ट्यूब में दो समान बैंड के रूप में दिखाई देता है।

questions.text: मानव कल्याण के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले जैवसक्रिय अणु साइक्लोस्पोरिन ए का स्रोत है :
questions.text_english: Bioactive molecule Cyclosporin A used for human welfare is derived from
questions.solution: The correct option is Trichoderma polysporum. Cyclosporin A is a valuable immunosuppressive agent used primarily in organ transplant patients to prevent rejection, and it is commercially produced by the fungus Trichoderma polysporum.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प ट्राइकोडर्मा पॉलीस्पोरम है। साइक्लोस्पोरिन ए एक प्रतिरक्षा निरोधक औषधि है जिसका उपयोग अंग प्रत्यारोपण के दौरान किया जाता है, और इसे ट्राइकोडर्मा पॉलीस्पोरम नामक कवक से प्राप्त किया जाता है।

questions.text: मटर के एक पौधे (पाइसम सैटाइवम) में फली का फूला हुआ आकार सिकुड़े आकार वाली फली पर प्रभावी है। एक क्रॉस जिसमें दोनों जनक विषमयुग्मजी फली के फूले हुए आकार वाले हैं, से प्राप्त संतति के लक्षणप्ररूप (फीनोटाइप) का अनुमानित अनुपात होगा :
questions.text_english: In a pea plant (Pisum sativum) inflated pod shape is dominant over constricted pod shape. The expected ratio of phenotypes of the offspring in a cross between both the parents with heterozygous inflated pod shape will be
questions.solution: The correct option is 3:1. When two heterozygous parents (Ii x Ii) are crossed, the resulting offspring follow Mendelian monohybrid cross principles, yielding a phenotypic ratio of 3 dominant (inflated) to 1 recessive (constricted).
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प 3:1 है। जब दो विषमयुग्मजी जनकों (Ii x Ii) के बीच संकरण कराया जाता है, तो मेंडल के एकसंकर संकरण के नियमानुसार संतति का लक्षणप्ररूप अनुपात 3 (प्रभावी) : 1 (अप्रभावी) होता है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): संक्रमित पौधों से विषाणु-मुक्त (वायरस रहित) पौधे प्राप्त करने के लिए उनके विभज्योतकों का 'पात्रे' संवर्धन किया जाता है।
कारण (R) : यदि पौधा विषाणु से संक्रमित होता है, तो उसकी जड़ें तथा स्तम्भ (तना) विषाणु मुक्त रहते हैं।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The meristems are grown 'in vitro' to obtain virus-free plants from an infected plant.
Reason (R): If the plant is infected with a virus, the roots and the stems are free of virus.
questions.instruction_line: इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer to these questions from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु कारण (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (C). The assertion is true because apical and axillary meristems are generally free of viruses and can be used in tissue culture to generate healthy plants. However, the reason is false because the roots and stems of an infected plant are indeed heavily infected by the virus; only the meristematic regions remain virus-free.
questions.solution_hindi: सही विकल्प (C) है। अभिकथन सत्य है क्योंकि शीर्षस्थ और कक्षस्थ विभज्योतक (meristems) विषाणु-मुक्त होते हैं। लेकिन कारण गलत है क्योंकि एक संक्रमित पौधे की जड़ें और तने भी विषाणु से संक्रमित होते हैं, केवल विभज्योतक भाग ही संक्रमण से मुक्त रहता है।
questions.chapter: Strategies for Enhancement in Food Production

sub_questions.text_english: Explain how the immunity of a person is affected if there is atrophy (degeneration) of the thymus gland at an early stage of life.

key_points: The thymus is the primary lymphoid organ where T-lymphocytes mature.
Its early degeneration will lead to a lack of mature T-cells, severely weakening cell-mediated immunity.

sub_questions.solution: The thymus gland acts as a primary lymphoid organ where immature lymphocytes undergo differentiation and maturation into antigen-sensitive T-lymphocytes. If the thymus degenerates at an early stage of life, the individual will fail to produce mature T-cells. This will result in a severely compromised cell-mediated immune system, leaving the person highly susceptible to various infections and diseases.

questions.text_english:
Assume that the given mRNA (start site is not depicted) is theoretically translated in two reading frames.
(a) Translation starting from the first nucleotide (Reading frame 1)
(b) Translation starting from the second nucleotide (Reading frame 2)
Frame 1: 5'-CUCGCUUGCCGAUCAAGGGUUA – 3'
Frame 2: 5'-GUGGCACUCAGUCCUUAAUGGCG-3'
Answer the following question :
How many amino acids will be specified in case (a) and case (b) on translation? Justify your answer.

key_points: Case (a) specifies 7 amino acids because there are 7 complete triplets and no stop codon.
Case (b) specifies 5 amino acids because the sequence encounters the stop codon UAA after 5 triplets, terminating translation.

questions.solution: In case (a), translation produces exactly 7 amino acids. The sequence breaks down into 7 continuous triplet codons (CUC, GCU, UGC, CGA, UCA, AGG, GUU) with no intervening stop codon. In case (b), the translation will produce only 5 amino acids. This is because the sequence of triplet codons (GUG, GCA, CUC, AGU, CCU) is immediately followed by 'UAA', which is a universal stop codon. The stop codon terminates the translation process prematurely.
questions.solution_hindi: केस (अ) में कुल 7 ऐमीनो अम्ल कूटलेखित होंगे क्योंकि इसमें 7 लगातार ट्रिपलेट कोडॉन हैं और कोई स्टॉप कोडॉन नहीं है। केस (ब) में केवल 5 ऐमीनो अम्ल बनेंगे क्योंकि पाँच कोडॉन के ठीक बाद एक स्टॉप कोडॉन (UAA) मौजूद है, जो स्थानांतरण प्रक्रिया को वहीं रोक देता है।

↓ एंज़ाइम A

↓

↓
चरण-4: ई. कोलाई में पुनर्योगज डीएनए अणु का प्रतिकृतियन

(ग) संवाहक डीएनए तथा विजातीय (बाहरी) डीएनए दोनों को काटने के लिए एक ही प्रतिबंधन एंज़ाइम EcoR I का उपयोग करने का औचित्य (न्यायसंगतता) सिद्ध कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
The basic scheme of the essential steps involved in the process of recombinant DNA technology is summarized below in the form of a flow diagram. Study the given flow diagram and answer the questions that follow.
Step-1: Vector DNA (cut using Restriction Enzyme EcoR I) + Alien DNA (cut using Restriction Enzyme EcoR I)
↓ Enzyme A
Step-2: Recombinant DNA molecule
↓
Step-3: Transfer of recombinant DNA molecule in E. coli (Host)
↓
Step-4: Replication of recombinant DNA molecule in E. coli
(a) Name the enzyme used in Step-1 to join the cut plasmid and alien DNA.
(b) State the technical term used for Step-3.
(c) Justify the use of same Restriction Enzyme EcoR I to cut both the vector DNA and the alien DNA.

key_points: a) DNA Ligase.
b) Transformation.
c) Ensures generation of identical sticky ends on both molecules to facilitate correct joining.

questions.solution:
(a) The enzyme A used to join the cut plasmid and alien DNA fragments is DNA Ligase. 
(b) The technical term used for the transfer of a recombinant DNA molecule into a host bacterium like E. coli is Transformation.
(c) The same restriction enzyme, EcoRI, must be used to cut both the vector and the alien DNA so that it generates identical complementary 'sticky ends' on both fragments. This compatibility is essential for the DNA ligase to successfully join them together to form recombinant DNA.

(क) कटे हुए प्लाज्मिड और बाहरी डीएनए को जोड़ने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले एंज़ाइम का नाम डीएनए लाइगेज (DNA Ligase) है।
(ख) ई. कोलाई (होस्ट) में पुनर्योगज डीएनए अणु के स्थानांतरण की प्रक्रिया को रूपान्तरण (Transformation) कहते हैं।
(ग) एक ही प्रतिबंधन एंज़ाइम का उपयोग इसलिए किया जाता है ताकि संवाहक और बाहरी डीएनए दोनों में समान चिपचिपे सिरे (sticky ends) उत्पन्न हो सकें, जो उन्हें आपस में आसानी से जुड़ने में मदद करते हैं।

sub_questions.text_english: Explain how the interaction between sea anemone and clownfish is one of the best examples of commensalism in nature.

key_points: Commensalism is an interaction where one species benefits and the other is neither harmed nor benefited.
Clownfish lives among stinging tentacles of anemone for protection from predators (benefits).
The sea anemone gains no clear advantage nor does it suffer harm from the clownfish.

sub_questions.solution: Commensalism is an ecological interaction in which one species benefits while the other is neither harmed nor benefited. The clownfish finds refuge among the stinging tentacles of the sea anemone, which protects the fish from its natural predators. Meanwhile, the sea anemone is completely unaffected by the presence of the clownfish, deriving no distinct benefit or harm, making it a classic example of commensalism.

questions.text_english: Explain the process of formation of placenta in a human female after the implantation of the blastocyst in the endometrium of the uterus.

key_points: After implantation, finger-like projections called chorionic villi appear on the trophoblast.
These villi are surrounded by the uterine tissue and maternal blood.
The chorionic villi and uterine tissue become interdigitated with each other, jointly forming the structural and functional unit called placenta.

questions.solution: Following the implantation of the blastocyst into the uterine endometrium, finger-like cellular projections start to appear on the outer layer called the trophoblast. These delicate projections are known as chorionic villi. Gradually, these chorionic villi become entirely surrounded and deeply embedded within the maternal uterine tissue and maternal blood supply. As development proceeds, the chorionic villi and the maternal uterine tissue interdigitate extensively with each other. This tight physical and vascular integration forms a specialized structural and functional unit between the developing embryo and the maternal body, which is known as the placenta.
questions.solution_hindi: गर्भाशय में कोरकपुटी (blastocyst) के अंतर्रोपण के बाद, ट्रोफोब्लास्ट की बाहरी परत पर उंगली जैसी संरचनाएँ उभरती हैं, जिन्हें जरायु अंकुरक (chorionic villi) कहा जाता है। ये अंकुरक मातृ गर्भाशय के ऊतकों और मातृ रक्त से घिरे होते हैं। धीरे-धीरे, ये जरायु अंकुरक और गर्भाशय के ऊतक एक-दूसरे के साथ गहराई से जुड़ जाते हैं। इस गहन जुड़ाव और संरचनात्मक एकीकरण के परिणामस्वरूप विकासशील भ्रूण और माता के शरीर के बीच एक संरचनात्मक और कार्यात्मक इकाई का निर्माण होता है जिसे अपरा (प्लेसेंटा) कहते हैं।

questions.text_english:
Gregor Mendel conducted hybridisation experiments in garden pea for seven years and proposed the law of inheritance.
(a) Why was he successful in his hybridisation experiments ? Give two reasons.
(b) State the law of independent assortment as proposed by Mendel after his dihybrid crosses.

key_points: a) Success reasons: Applied statistical analysis and mathematical logic; kept accurate records of large sampling sizes; chose pure-breeding pea lines.
b) Law of Independent Assortment: When two pairs of traits are combined in a hybrid, segregation of one pair of characters is independent of the other pair of characters.

questions.solution:
(a) Mendel was highly successful because he was the first to apply rigorous statistical analysis and mathematical logic to biological problems. Additionally, he conducted experiments with a large sampling size, which gave high credibility to his data, and strictly utilized true-breeding pure pea lines for specific observable traits.
(b) The Law of Independent Assortment states that when two pairs of contrasting traits are combined in a single dihybrid cross, the segregation of one pair of alleles during gamete formation is completely independent of the segregation of the other pair of alleles.

questions.text_english:
Study the given below single strand of deoxyribonucleic acid depicted in the form of a "stick" diagram with 5'-3' end directionality, sugars as vertical lines and bases as single letter abbreviations and answer the questions that follow.
(a) Name the covalent bonds depicted as (a) and (b) in the form of slanting lines in the diagram.
(b) How many purines are present in the given "stick" diagram?
(c) Draw the chemical structure of the given polynucleotide chain of DNA.

key_points: a) (a) is Phosphoester bond; (b) is Phosphodiester bond.
b) Two purines (Adenine 'A' and Guanine 'G').
c) Draw a trinucleotide chain showing deoxyribose sugars connected via phosphodiester linkages at 3' and 5' carbons, with bases A, T, G attached at the 1' position via N-glycosidic bonds.

questions.solution:
(a) In the depicted diagram, bond (a) represents a Phosphoester bond (connecting the terminal phosphate to the 5' carbon of the first sugar). Bond (b) represents a Phosphodiester bond, which links the 3' carbon of one sugar to the 5' carbon of the subsequent sugar along the backbone.
(b) There are exactly two purines present in the given stick diagram, which are Adenine (A) and Guanine (G). Thymine (T) is a pyrimidine.
(c) To represent the chemical structure, one must draw a complete trinucleotide chain. It involves sketching three deoxyribose sugar rings. The first sugar has a phosphate group at the 5' position and an Adenine attached to the 1' carbon via an N-glycosidic bond. Its 3' carbon links via a phosphate group to the 5' carbon of the second sugar (bearing Thymine). The second sugar's 3' carbon connects to the third sugar (bearing Guanine), which terminates with a free hydroxyl (-OH) group at its 3' position.

questions.text: किसी वाहित मल उपचार संयंत्र (STP) में जब प्राथमिक बहिःस्राव को बड़े वायुवीय टैंकों में गुज़ारा जाता है, तो उस जीवविज्ञानीय उपचार की व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Explain the biological treatment of primary effluent when passed into the large aeration tanks in a sewage treatment plant (STP).

key_points: Primary effluent is constantly agitated mechanically and air is pumped into it.
This allows vigorous growth of useful aerobic microbes into flocs (masses of bacteria associated with fungal filaments).
These microbes consume the major part of organic matter, significantly reducing the Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD) of the effluent.

questions.solution: During the biological treatment in a Sewage Treatment Plant, the primary effluent is transferred into large aeration tanks where it is constantly mechanically agitated, and air is actively pumped into it. This rich oxygenation promotes the rapid and vigorous growth of useful aerobic microbes, which clump together to form 'flocs' (masses of bacteria intertwined with fungal filaments). While multiplying, these vigorous microbes consume a vast majority of the organic matter present in the effluent. As a direct result of this microbial action, the Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) of the effluent is drastically reduced, purifying the water.

questions.text_english:
Given below is a flower with its characteristic features specialised for the most common type of abiotic pollination.
Answer the following questions based on the above diagram:
(a) Name the mode of abiotic pollination that will be adopted by the given plant species in the above picture.
(b) State the need of exposed large feathery stigmas for the flower.
(c) What will be the two important adaptations in the pollen grains of the flowers pollinated by the above mode of pollination?
(d) What could be the probable reason for the petals being small and non-green?

key_points: a) Anemophily (Wind pollination).
b) Exposed feathery stigmas easily trap and catch the air-borne pollen grains.
c) Pollen grains must be extremely light and non-sticky so they can be transported effortlessly by air currents.
d) They do not need large, bright, or nectar-producing petals to attract insect pollinators, so energy is saved.

questions.solution:
(a) The diagram depicts floral structures highly adapted for Anemophily, which is the mode of abiotic pollination carried out by wind.
(b) The flower possesses heavily exposed and large feathery stigmas. This specific adaptation allows the stigma to act like a net, effectively catching and trapping the drifting air-borne pollen grains from the wind currents.
(c) Two crucial adaptations required for pollen grains in wind-pollinated flowers are that they must be exceptionally light in weight and completely non-sticky. This ensures they can be effortlessly dispersed and carried over long distances by gentle wind currents.
(d) The petals are characteristically small, inconspicuous, and non-green because wind-pollinated plants do not rely on insects or animal agents for pollination. Thus, there is absolutely no evolutionary need for them to expend energy on producing large, colorful, or fragrant petals to attract pollinators.

questions.text_english:
According to a recent wildlife report, the biggest threat to the tiger's survival in Mudumalai Tiger Reserve (MTR) was found to be a small, beautiful flower, Lantana camara, a tropical American shrub, that invaded 40% of India's tiger range. Tamil Nadu department's Lantana weed eradication drive helped to restore the dying MTR thereby also reducing human-wildlife conflicts. MTR is home to 25 species of grasses and legumes.
Answer the given questions based on the information given above.
(a) Explain how did the removal of Lantana help in restoring the dying Mudumalai Tiger Reserve.
(b) Why is the invasion of Lantana camara a cause of concern in MTR.

key_points: a) Removing Lantana allowed the native grasses and legumes to regenerate. This increased the food supply for herbivores, which in turn increased the prey base for tigers.

b) Lantana is an invasive alien species. It rapidly outcompetes and suppresses native flora (grasses/legumes), leading to severe habitat loss for native herbivores and disrupting the entire food chain.

questions.solution:
(a) The meticulous removal and eradication of the invasive Lantana shrub cleared the forest floor, allowing the 25 native species of grasses and legumes to successfully regenerate and thrive. The restoration of this native vegetation greatly increased the primary food source for local herbivores like deer. A healthy and abundant herbivore population automatically provided an adequate natural prey base for the tigers, thereby saving the reserve and reducing the tigers' need to wander into human settlements for food.
(b) The invasion of Lantana camara is a massive cause of concern because it acts as an aggressive alien invasive species. It outcompetes and severely suppresses the growth of the native grasses and legumes. This massive loss of native flora starves the primary consumers (herbivores), ultimately causing a cascading collapse of the entire ecosystem's food web, drastically threatening top predators like tigers.

questions.text_english: Enlist one advantage and two disadvantages of green revolution.

key_points: Advantage: Drastically increased crop yields and food production, helping to meet the food requirements of a growing population.
Disadvantage 1: Extensive use of agrochemicals (fertilizers and pesticides) severely degraded soil health and caused environmental pollution.
Disadvantage 2: Over-reliance on irrigation caused depletion of groundwater resources.

questions.solution:
One major advantage of the Green Revolution was that it drastically multiplied agricultural yields and overall food production through the introduction of high-yielding varieties of crops, ensuring food security for a rapidly growing population.
However, it brought significant disadvantages. Firstly, the heavy and continuous reliance on chemical fertilizers and potent pesticides led to severe soil degradation, loss of natural soil fertility, and widespread water pollution. Secondly, the intensive water requirements for these high-yielding crop varieties resulted in dangerous depletion of underground water tables and increased soil salinity.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किसी एक प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.text_english: Answer any one of the following:

sub_questions.text:
(i) पुष्पी पादपों में द्विनिषेचन कैसे होता है ? व्याख्या कीजिए।
(ii) इन पौधों में द्विनिषेचन के पश्चात् निर्मित उत्पादों (संरचनाओं) का भावी परिणाम लिखिए ।
sub_questions.text_english:
(i) Explain how does double fertilisation take place in a flowering plant.
(ii) Write the fate of the products of double fertilization in these plants.

key_points: Double fertilization involves two simultaneous fusions: Syngamy and Triple Fusion.
Syngamy: One male gamete fuses with the egg cell to form a diploid zygote.
Triple Fusion: The second male gamete fuses with the two polar nuclei in the central cell to form a triploid Primary Endosperm Nucleus (PEN).
Fate: Zygote develops into an embryo.
Fate: PEN develops into the nutritive endosperm.

sub_questions.solution:
(i) Double fertilisation is a unique phenomenon characteristic of angiosperms. Upon reaching the synergids inside the embryo sac, the pollen tube releases two non-motile male gametes. One male gamete actively moves towards the egg cell and fuses with its nucleus. This fusion is called syngamy and results in the formation of a diploid cell, the zygote. The second male gamete travels towards the large central cell and fuses with the two haploid polar nuclei (or secondary nucleus) located there. Since this second fusion involves three haploid nuclei, it is termed triple fusion. The product is a triploid Primary Endosperm Nucleus (PEN). Because two types of fusions—syngamy and triple fusion—occur simultaneously in the same embryo sac, the entire process is collectively termed double fertilisation.
(ii) Following double fertilization, the products have distinct evolutionary fates. The diploid zygote undergoes embryonic development to form the mature embryo, which carries the future plant. Concurrently, the triploid Primary Endosperm Nucleus (PEN) rapidly divides and differentiates into the endosperm, a nutrient-rich tissue that provides vital nourishment to the developing embryo. Ultimately, the entire ovule matures into a seed.

sub_questions.text:
(i) पुरुषों (मानव नर जनन तंत्र) में वृषण पालिका (टेस्टिकुलर लोब्युल्स) की संरचना की व्याख्या कीजिए। शुक्रजनक नलिकाओं में पाई जाने वाली दो प्रकार की कोशिकाओं के नाम लिखिए तथा उनकी भूमिका बताइए ।
(ii) शुक्रजनन के प्रक्रम में अधश्चेतक (हाइपोथैलेमिक) हॉर्मोन (GnRH) की भूमिका का वर्णन कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
(i) Explain the structure of testicular lobules in human male reproductive system. Name the two types of cells present in the seminiferous tubules and state their role.
(ii) Describe the role of hypothalamic hormone GnRH in spermatogenesis.

key_points: Testis is divided into about 250 compartments called testicular lobules. Each lobule contains 1 to 3 highly coiled seminiferous tubules.
Cells in tubules: Male germ cells (spermatogonia) which undergo meiosis to form sperms, and Sertoli cells which provide nourishment to germ cells.
GnRH from hypothalamus stimulates the anterior pituitary to secrete two gonadotropins: LH and FSH.
LH acts on Leydig cells to synthesize androgens, which drive spermatogenesis.
FSH acts on Sertoli cells stimulating factors that help in the process of spermiogenesis.

sub_questions.solution:
(i) In the human male reproductive system, each oval-shaped testis is internally divided into approximately 250 distinct compartments, which are known as testicular lobules. Inside each testicular lobule, there are one to three highly coiled structures called seminiferous tubules, which serve as the actual sites for sperm production. The inner lining of these seminiferous tubules contains two highly specialized types of cells. The first are the male germ cells, or spermatogonia, which undergo meiotic divisions to ultimately produce haploid sperms. The second type are the tall Sertoli cells, which act as nurse cells and provide essential nutrition and structural support to the developing germ cells.
(ii) The process of spermatogenesis is strictly regulated by hormones, primarily initiated by the significant increase in the secretion of Gonadotropin Releasing Hormone (GnRH) from the hypothalamus at puberty. Increased levels of GnRH act directly on the anterior pituitary gland, stimulating it to secrete two critical gonadotropins: Luteinizing Hormone (LH) and Follicle Stimulating Hormone (FSH). LH acts primarily on the interstitial Leydig cells, stimulating them to synthesize and secrete male androgens like testosterone, which subsequently drive the process of spermatogenesis. Meanwhile, FSH acts on the Sertoli cells, prompting the secretion of specific factors that are essential for the final maturation phase, spermiogenesis.

sub_questions.text_english: Name and explain the biotechnological strategy wherein the infection by the nematode Meloidegyne incognitia can be prevented using Agrobacterium vectors in the roots of tobacco plant by RNA interference.

key_points: Strategy: RNA interference (RNAi).
Using Agrobacterium vectors, nematode-specific genes are carefully introduced into the host tobacco plant.
The introduced DNA produces both sense and anti-sense RNA in the host cells.
These two RNAs, being complementary, fold and bind to form double-stranded RNA (dsRNA).
This dsRNA triggers RNAi, which specifically binds to and silences the specific mRNA of the invading nematode, thereby preventing its translation and killing the parasite.

sub_questions.solution: The highly effective biotechnological strategy utilized here is known as RNA interference (RNAi), which takes place in all eukaryotic organisms as a method of cellular defense. In this procedure, scientists use Agrobacterium vectors to systematically introduce nematode-specific genes into the vulnerable host tobacco plant. The introduction of this specific DNA is designed in such a way that it produces both sense and anti-sense RNA inside the host cells. Because these two RNA strands are perfectly complementary to each other, they instantly bind together to form a double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) molecule. This unique dsRNA molecule immediately initiates the RNAi mechanism. Consequently, when the parasitic nematode Meloidogyne incognitia infects the roots and feeds on the plant cells, it ingests these molecules. The RNAi machinery then specifically binds to and degrades the corresponding essential messenger RNA (mRNA) of the nematode. This phenomenon, known as mRNA silencing, entirely halts the translation process, meaning the nematode cannot synthesize vital proteins. Deprived of these life-sustaining proteins, the parasite quickly perishes, and the transgenic tobacco plant is saved from root knot disease.

sub_questions.text: पॉलीमरेज श्रृंखला अभिक्रिया (पॉलीमरेज चेन रिएक्शन) (पीसीआर) तकनीक के उपयोग द्वारा लाभकारी जीन के प्रवर्धन (आवर्धन) की व्याख्या कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the amplification of gene of interest using the technique of Polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

key_points: PCR is a technique to synthesize multiple copies of a gene of interest in vitro.
Step 1: Denaturation. Target dsDNA is heated (94°C) to separate its two strands.
Step 2: Annealing. Two sets of oligonucleotide primers bind to complementary regions at the 3' ends of the separated strands at a lower temperature (50-60°C).
Step 3: Extension. Thermostable Taq DNA polymerase extends the primers using free deoxynucleotides (dNTPs) at an optimal temperature (72°C).
The cycle is repeated roughly 30 times, exponentially amplifying the DNA segment approximately a billion times.

sub_questions.solution:
The Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) is a revolutionary molecular biological technique used to exponentially amplify a specific gene of interest in vitro. This automated process occurs in three distinct, temperature-controlled steps.
The first step is Denaturation, where the target double-stranded DNA sample is heated to a high temperature of roughly 94°C. This extreme heat breaks the weak hydrogen bonds between the nitrogenous bases, effectively separating the DNA into two independent single strands that will act as templates.
The second step is Annealing. The temperature is deliberately lowered to about 50-60°C, allowing two sets of short, chemically synthesized oligonucleotide primers to attach (anneal) precisely to their complementary target sequences located at the 3' ends of both single DNA strands.
The third and final step is Extension. The temperature is raised to 72°C, which is optimal for a specialised, heat-tolerant enzyme called Taq DNA polymerase (isolated from Thermus aquaticus). This enzyme adds free deoxynucleotides (dNTPs) to the primers, extending them and synthesizing complete new complementary strands. When this three-step cycle is repeated repeatedly, usually around 30 times, the segment of DNA is amplified nearly a billion times, yielding a massive quantity of the desired gene for further biotechnological applications.

(i) प्रकृति में किसी जाति की एक समष्टि में, जब उसके पास संसाधन सीमित हों, तो उसके समष्टि वृद्धि वक्र का वर्णन कीजिए।
(ii) इस वृद्धि वक्र का समीकरण लिखिए ।
(iii) इस वृद्धि वक्र का नाम लिखकर इस प्रकार के समष्टि वक्र का प्रदर्शन करने हेतु ग्राफीय आरेख बनाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english:
(i) Describe the population growth curve applicable in a population of any species in nature that has limited resources at its disposal.
(ii) Give the equation of this growth curve.
(iii) Name the growth curve and depict a graphical plot for this type of population growth.

key_points: When resources are limited, the population exhibits a logistic growth curve.
It initially shows a lag phase, followed by phases of acceleration and deceleration, and finally an asymptote when population density reaches the carrying capacity (K).
Equation: dN/dt = rN [(K - N) / K]
The growth curve is known as Verhulst-Pearl Logistic Growth.
The graphical plot is an S-shaped (sigmoid) curve plotting population density (N) against time (t).

sub_questions.solution:
(i) In nature, practically all habitats possess limited resources that restrict unrestricted growth. A population growing in such a limited resource environment exhibits a specific pattern. Initially, the population establishes itself slowly, representing a 'lag phase'. As they adapt, this is followed by a phase of rapid acceleration (log phase) where growth is exponential. However, as the environmental resistance increases due to resource depletion and competition, the growth enters a phase of deceleration. Ultimately, the population density reaches a stable upper limit known as the carrying capacity (K), leading to an asymptote where the birth rate matches the death rate.
(ii) The mathematical equation governing this realistic population growth is written as: dN/dt = rN [(K - N) / K], where N stands for population density at time t, r represents the intrinsic rate of natural increase, and K stands for the carrying capacity of that specific environment.
(iii) This particular mathematical model of population growth is scientifically named the Verhulst-Pearl Logistic Growth curve. When this growth is plotted on a graph, with Population density (N) on the vertical y-axis and Time (t) on the horizontal x-axis, it yields a highly characteristic S-shaped, or Sigmoid, curve indicating stable ecological equilibrium.

sub_questions.text_english:
(i) Explain the Species-Area relationship within a natural forest and also predict the nature of graph when species richness is plotted against the area for a wide variety of taxa.
(ii) Depict the graphical relationship between species richness and area.
(iii) Give the equation of the Species-Area relationship for a wide variety of taxa on a logarithmic scale.

key_points: German naturalist Alexander von Humboldt observed that within a region, species richness increases with increasing explored area, but only up to a limit.
When plotted on a normal graph, this relationship forms a rectangular hyperbola.
Graphical representation plots Species richness on the Y-axis and Area on the X-axis showing the curve.
On a logarithmic scale, the relationship forms a straight line.
Equation on logarithmic scale: log S = log C + Z log A.

sub_questions.solution:
(i) The core concept of the Species-Area relationship was first formulated by the great German naturalist and geographer Alexander von Humboldt during his extensive explorations. He observed that within any natural forest or ecological region, the species richness increases as the explored area increases, but critically, this increase only occurs up to a certain limit. When this intricate relationship is plotted on a standard graph for a wide variety of taxonomic groups—such as angiosperm plants, birds, bats, or freshwater fishes—the resulting curve is consistently a rectangular hyperbola.
(ii) The graphical plot representing this ecological rule features 'Area' on the horizontal X-axis and 'Species richness' on the vertical Y-axis. The resulting plot is a sharply rising curve that eventually flattens out, forming the rectangular hyperbola described mathematically as S = CA^Z.
(iii) When the exact same relationship is plotted using a logarithmic scale, it translates into a perfectly straight line, making analysis simpler. The mathematical equation for this linear logarithmic relationship is expressed as: log S = log C + Z log A, where 'S' is Species richness, 'A' is the Area, 'Z' is the slope of the line (regression coefficient), and 'C' is the Y-intercept.
